label: Read-only scoring audit of validation_150_baseline.json. Not a replacement score and not an estimate of overall financial accuracy.

official_score.rule: Stored answer_correct from evaluation/scoring.py. A leading minus is not part of the selected number. Abstention is not correct.

signed_number_diagnostic.rule: Same comparison, unit conversion, and tolerances as evaluation/scoring.py, except a minus sign immediately before the number selected by that scorer is kept. A minus elsewhere in a calculation formula is not applied. Abstention remains not correct. Recomputed from the saved predicted_answer and gold fields. Exactly eight saved items change, all from incorrect to correct.

note: Appropriate abstentions are not added to the official numerator. The signed diagnostic is not the stored score.
